crossRefs.note: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be…
Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of…

translations.web: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
translations.bsb: While they were there, the time came for her Child to be born.
translations.kjv: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, while they were there, the days were fulfilled that she should be delivered.
